Class AbstractSockJsService

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.socket.sockjs.support.AbstractSockJsService
All Implemented Interfaces:
CorsConfigurationSource, SockJsService
Direct Known Subclasses:
TransportHandlingSockJsService
public abstract class AbstractSockJsService extends Object implements SockJsService, CorsConfigurationSource
An abstract base class for SockJsService implementations that provides SockJS path resolution and handling of static SockJS requests (for example, "/info", "/iframe.html", etc). Sub-classes must handle session URLs (i.e. transport-specific requests).

默认情况下，仅允许同源请求。使用setAllowedOrigins(Collection)指定允许的源列表（包含 "*" 的列表将允许所有源）。

Since:
4.0
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev，Sebastien Deleuze

    • setSockJsClientLibraryUrl

      public void setSockJsClientLibraryUrl(String clientLibraryUrl)
      Transports with no native cross-domain communication (for example, "eventsource", "htmlfile") must get a simple page from the "foreign" domain in an invisible iframe so that code in the iframe can run from a domain local to the SockJS server. Since the iframe needs to load the SockJS JavaScript client library, this property allows specifying where to load it from.

      默认情况下，此设置指向 "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/sockjs/1.0.0/sockjs.min.js"。不过，也可以将其设置为指向应用程序提供的 URL。

      请注意，可以指定相对 URL，此时该 URL 必须相对于 `iframe` 的 URL。例如，假设 SockJS 端点映射到 "/sockjs"，生成的 `iframe` URL 为 "/sockjs/iframe.html"，则相对 URL 必须以 "../../" 开头，以便向上遍历到 SockJS 映射位置之上的目录。如果是基于前缀的 Servlet 映射，可能需要多进行一次遍历。

    • setStreamBytesLimit

      public void setStreamBytesLimit(int streamBytesLimit)
      Streaming transports save responses on the client side and don't free memory used by delivered messages. Such transports need to recycle the connection once in a while. This property sets a minimum number of bytes that can be sent over a single HTTP streaming request before it will be closed. After that client will open a new request. Setting this value to one effectively disables streaming and will make streaming transports to behave like polling transports.

      默认值为 128K（即 128 * 1024）。

    • getStreamBytesLimit

      public int getStreamBytesLimit()
      返回在单个 HTTP 流式请求关闭之前可以发送的最小字节数。

    • setSessionCookieNeeded

      public void setSessionCookieNeeded(boolean sessionCookieNeeded)
      The SockJS protocol requires a server to respond to an initial "/info" request from clients with a "cookie_needed" boolean property that indicates whether the use of a JSESSIONID cookie is required for the application to function correctly, for example, for load balancing or in Java Servlet containers for the use of an HTTP session.

      这对于支持 XDomainRequest（一种修改后的 AJAX/XHR，可跨域发送请求但不发送任何 Cookie）的 IE 8 和 IE 9 尤为重要。在这些情况下，SockJS 客户端首选 "iframe-htmlfile" 传输方式而非 "xdr-streaming"，以便能够发送 Cookie。

      SockJS 协议还期望当此属性设置为 true 时，SockJS 服务会回显 JSESSIONID cookie。然而，在 Servlet 容器中运行时则不需要，因为容器会自动处理它。

      默认值为 "true"，以最大化应用程序在 IE 8、9 中配合 Cookie（特别是 JSESSIONID Cookie）支持正确运行的机会。然而，如果不需要使用 Cookie（和 HTTP 会话），应用程序可以选择将其设置为 "false"。

    • isSessionCookieNeeded

    • setHttpMessageCacheSize

      public void setHttpMessageCacheSize(int httpMessageCacheSize)
      The number of server-to-client messages that a session can cache while waiting for the next HTTP polling request from the client. All HTTP transports use this property since even streaming transports recycle HTTP requests periodically.

      HTTP 请求之间的时间间隔应相对较短，且不得超过允许的断开延迟（参见setDisconnectDelay(long)）；默认值为 5 秒。

      默认大小为 100。

    • getHttpMessageCacheSize

      public int getHttpMessageCacheSize()
      返回 HTTP 消息缓存的大小。

    • setAllowedOrigins

      public void setAllowedOrigins(Collection<String> allowedOrigins)
      Set the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser. Please, refer to CorsConfiguration.setAllowedOrigins(List) for format details and considerations, and keep in mind that the CORS spec does not allow use of "*" with allowCredentials=true. For more flexible origin patterns use setAllowedOriginPatterns(Collection) instead.

      默认情况下，不允许任何源。当同时设置`allowedOriginPatterns`时，该属性优先于此属性。

      注意：当启用 SockJS 并限制源时，不允许检查请求源的传输类型（基于 iframe 的传输）将被禁用。因此，当限制源时，不支持 IE 6 到 9。

      Since:
      4.1.2
      See Also:
      • setAllowedOriginPatterns(Collection)
      • RFC 6454：Web 源概念
      • SockJS 支持的浏览器传输方式

    • handleRequest

      public final void handleRequest(ServerHttpRequest request, ServerHttpResponse response, @Nullable String sockJsPath, WebSocketHandler wsHandler) throws SockJsException
      此方法确定 SockJS 路径并处理 SockJS 静态 URL。会话 URL 和原始 WebSocket 请求已委托给抽象方法。
      Specified by:
      `handleRequest` 接口 `SockJsService` 中
      Parameters:
      request - 当前请求
      response - 当前响应
      sockJsPath - SockJS 服务前缀内的路径剩余部分
      wsHandler - 用于与 SockJS 客户端交换消息的处理器
      Throws:
      SockJsException - 在请求处理失败时抛出；通常，向客户端发送消息的失败尝试会自动关闭 SockJS 会话并抛出SockJsTransportFailureException；从客户端读取消息的失败尝试不会自动关闭会话，并可能导致SockJsMessageDeliveryException 或SockJsException；来自 WebSocketHandler 的异常可以通过内部处理或通过ExceptionWebSocketHandlerDecorator 或某些替代装饰器进行处理。前者在使用SockJsHttpRequestHandler时会自动添加。
